title: Principal Investigator, Cross-Asset Momentum Lab
verdict_why: No out-of-sample edge and the regime rarely speaks (decisive only 4.5% of cycles). A signal that rarely speaks and never beats the baseline is not a signal — I recommend weight 0 and the ledger records the refutation.
verdict_plain: Cora's verdict: the evidence says cross-asset momentum carries no usable signal. She recommends removing it from the model entirely — a negative result, published honestly.
model_gates: APPLY_CANDIDATE nominates only. Adoption requires the runner's champion/challenger gates: held-out Brier improvement ≥ 2e-4, positive in both halves, family-wise α=0.05 with Bonferroni correction, ≥24h between adoptions; weight climbs a small gated ladder from 0 rather than jumping. WITHDRAW recommends xassetWeight 0. This file never changes a weight directly.

hypotheses.claim: Trailing-hour ETH/SOL momentum spills over into XRP direction: when the majors drift together, XRP tends to follow.
hypotheses.prediction: decisive momentum reads align with 24h XRP direction more often than chance

hypotheses.claim: The cross-asset momentum member beats the baseline forecast out-of-sample on Brier score.
hypotheses.prediction: member Brier < baseline Brier over n ≥ 200 scored forecasts

hypotheses.claim: Spillover is a broad-market story: ETH and SOL momentum usually agree, and agreement is when the tilt means the most.
hypotheses.prediction: ETH/SOL momentum signs agree on most healthy cycles; decisive reads cluster in agreement regimes

hypotheses.claim: The momentum regime expresses itself often enough to matter — not a once-a-quarter curiosity.
hypotheses.prediction: decisive_frac ≥ 0.40 over rolling history once n ≥ 100

disciplines_applied.assessment: The majors are mostly quiet (4.5% decisive). Momentum measured in log-returns, standardized per asset — I do not narrate silence.
decisive_frac=4.5% over n=200; no out-of-sample edge — the scoreboard overrules the candle bench. Spillover is subtle — I size my claims to my sample.
No edge to explain — I will not invent a microstructure story for a statistic that is not there.
Pipeline healthy: candle feed reachable 99.0% of cycles; ETH and SOL on the same clock grid; same candle history reproduces the same numbers.
A signal that rarely speaks and never beats the baseline is not a signal — the risk-managed move is to withdraw, not to keep a dead hypothesis on life support.

Momentum is the most crowded anomaly in finance — by the time a move is obvious on the majors, the spillover into XRP has often already happened. The edge, if any, is in sustained broad-market drift, not chasing a single green candle. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.

Known: 4.5% decisive reads over 200 cycles, ETH/SOL agree 84.8% of healthy cycles. Unknown: whether correlations hold when stress hits — in stress everything correlates, in calm nothing does. Confidence: moderate — evidence-backed, still falsifiable.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
I sign this verdict: WITHDRAW. It is defensible from the record below, and I will reverse it the moment the evidence does.
